This art piece recognizes Moff Zsinj, a serving official of the Galactic Empire whose authority, visibility, and commanding presence have distinguished him among his contemporaries. locations.vanilla_source_en:
On July 25, 1976, the Viking 1 orbiter spacecraft took its first photos of the Cydonia region of Mars. Among them was an image of what appeared to be a humanoid face on the surface of Mars. The image inspired the imaginations of millions, cementing humanity's passion for space exploration and once again begging the question "Are we alone out there?" 

Later photography would reveal that the face was no more than a mountain, shadows, and perhaps humanity's greatest case of "pareidolia," a tendency to perceive specific, meaningful imagery in an otherwise ambiguous or random visual pattern. Nevertheless, the legend of the "Face on Mars" remains an important inspiration for many to this day.

There are three Damage Types:

- Physical - This is damage caused by explosions, bullets, and melee weapons.

- Energy - Caused by a beam of energy and is associated with lasers and particle guns.

- Electromagnetic - Disrupts electrical impulses. Highly effective against droids and ships, and can also stun humans.

Equipment can protect against these Damage Types. For more information, see the entry for "Equipment."

items.source_en:
You're making a good choice keeping us under contract, Mei. Even if they could break their jurisdiction, Rebel Alliance wouldn't keep you half as safe as we can. I know some of our contractors have a reputation for being rough around the edges, maybe even rude, but that reputation is part of why your establishment is so safe with us.

You'll notice that incidents of debtors skipping out have been down 79% since we started. Physical altercations between patrons are down 52%. And, pirate attacks? They're virtually non-existent. So, remember that when it comes time for our annual rates to go up. It's not just safer, it's good business sense.

-Madeleine Stocker

우리가 시작한 이후로 채무자가 도망치는 사건이 79% 줄어든 걸 알 수 있을 거야. 고객 간의 물리적 충돌은 52% 줄었지. 그리고 해적 습격? 사실상 전무해. 그러니 연간 요금을 인상할 때가 되면 그 점을 기억해 둬. 이건 단순히 더 안전해지는 게 아니라, 현명한 비즈니스 전략이니까.

-매들린 스토커

items.source_en:
We knew the risks going in, but getting this data was important. And now that we have it, Dr. Suruki wants us to dock at a Rebel starstation as if we didn't just steal their milk money.

He does have a point though. The math isn't in our favor. Common sense tells me I should nuke the data we stole, put everything into the engines, and slow crawl this ship to the nearest starstation. 

But I also know how valuable this data could be to MAST. On top of that, the Rebel's data recovery team might start poking around our systems -- flight patterns, deleted data, military crew -- and piece together a story we don't want them telling. So I don't want to make that call just yet.
items.legacy_ko:
위험을 감수하고 뛰어들었지만, 이 데이터를 확보하는 건 중요했다. 이제 손에 넣었으니, 수루키 박사는 우리가 방금 그들의 푼돈이나 훔친 게 아닌 것처럼 반란군 우주 정거장에 도킹하길 원한다.

박사의 말도 일리는 있다. 계산상 우리에게 불리하다. 상식적으로는 훔친 데이터를 날려버리고, 엔진에 모든 출력을 집중해서 가장 가까운 우주 정거장까지 기어가는 게 맞다.

하지만 이 데이터가 MAST에 얼마나 가치 있을지도 알고 있다. 게다가 반란군의 데이터 복구 팀이 우리 시스템(비행 패턴, 삭제된 데이터, 군 승무원 정보)을 뒤지기 시작하면, 우리가 들키고 싶지 않은 진실을 짜 맞출지도 모른다. 그래서 아직은 그런 결정을 내리고 싶지 않다.
